answer_2.quote: We calculate accuracy, F1-score, and Macro F1score between predicted labels and ground truth labels, to automatically evaluate all models on our dataset.

answer_3.quote: We compare our framework with ChatGPT 3, the latest large language model trained using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). To adopt ChatGPT to our task, we design the prompt template: "Given a story as a chain of events E 1 , E 2 , . . . , E n , which k event(s) in the first n -1 events more plausibly cause the last event?"
methods: prompt template asking which events cause the last event

answer_4.quote: We carried out human annotation on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Workers are asked to annotate whether an event causes the last event in a sequence.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are provided with event sequences and are asked to annotate whether an event causes the last event in a sequence.
